builds.hypothesis: R3 is400+0.6AP plus85+0.15AP per extra champion. Five legal enemies mean four extras:740+1.2AP per victim. AP and MR modifiers strengthen explosion. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Diana Pulls In, Slows by [40 / 50 / 60]%, and reveals nearby enemies for [2] seconds.

If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage plus [35 / 60 / 85 + (0.15) × AP] for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional [(35 / 60 / 85 + (0.15) × AP) × (5)] damage.

builds.name: Moonsilver Blade: one massive third hit
builds.summary: Explore a high Moonsilver Blade third-attack magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high Moonsilver Blade third-attack magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Diana's third attack adds a level-based magic cleave plus 0.5 AP. Deathcap and MR penetration target that bonus. Attack speed affects how often the third hit occurs, not the damage of this one cleave. A Nashor or Lich Bane alternative can improve the whole delivery event while lowering the named passive bonus; report those procs separately.

Diana creates three orbiting spheres for [5] seconds that explode on contact, each dealing [20 / 32 / 44 / 56 / 68 + (0.18) × AP] magic damage, up to a max of [(20 / 32 / 44 / 56 / 68 + (0.18) × AP) × (3)] damage.

Diana also gains [45 / 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 + (0.3) × AP + (0.14) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional [45 / 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 + (0.3) × AP + (0.14) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Shield and refreshes the duration.
